{'原文': 'Our longtime 9to5Toys readers will know that we have always been big fans of the Nomad brand – they have always put out what are simply some of the best iPhone cases on the market every year, and the all-new iPhone 18 Pro series is no exception. That said, we don’t often see deals available on the latest cases in the first few months after release – unless you’re using our exclusive Nomad promo code. Use code 9TO5MAC at checkout and you’ll get 25% off any of the brand’s new iPhone 18 Pro cases:', '譯文': '任何9to5Toys嘅忠實讀者都知道我哋幾鍾意Nomad呢個品牌。多年嚟，呢個品牌一直推出市面上數一數二出色嘅iPhone保護殼，今年全新嘅iPhone 18 Pro系列亦唔例外。不過喺新機推出頭幾個月通常都好少會有折扣，除非你用到我哋嘅獨家Nomad優惠碼——結賬時輸入9TO5MAC，即可以該品牌任何全新iPhone 18 Pro保護殼享有75折優惠。'}

{'原文': 'Nomad iPhone 18 Pro Cases – Exclusive promo code', '譯文': 'Nomad iPhone 18 Pro保護殼——獨家折扣碼'}

{'原文': 'Note: Enter promo code 9TO5MAC at checkout to see these exclusive prices below. Offer valid on iPhone 18 Pro/Max cases only, excludes iPhone Duo.', '譯文': '***注意：結賬時輸入優惠碼9TO5MAC即可享有以下獨家價格。優惠只適用於iPhone 18 Pro/Max保護殼，並不包括iPhone Duo。'}

  • {'原文': 'Modern Leather Case – Camino: $58 (Orig. $69)', '譯文': 'Modern Camino皮革保護殼 $58（原價$69）'}
  • {'原文': 'Modern Leather Case – Horween: $67 (Orig. $79)', '譯文': 'Modern Horween皮革保護殼 $67（原價$79）'}
  • {'原文': 'Traditional Leather Case – Camino: $67 (Orig. $79)', '譯文': 'Traditional Camino皮革保護殼 $67（原價$79）'}

  • {'原文': 'Sport Case: $46 (Orig. $55)', '譯文': 'Sport保護殼 $46（原價$55）'}

{'原文': 'And one last thing – you can still add a screen protector from Nomad to most case orders right now for only 20% off, just remember to add it to the same cart.', '譯文': '提提大家，而家買大部份Nomad保護殼仲可以同時以8折優惠加購屏幕保護貼——記緊加入同一個購物車。'}

{'原文': 'Personally, I’ve always been a big fan of the brand’s Traditional Leather Case, but its dual-tone Modern Leather option has grown on me over the years. This year, I was lucky enough to get my hands on its limited-edition Bordeaux to match the iPhone 18 Pro, and it looks just as good as ever.', '譯文': '我就好鍾意Nomad嘅Traditional Leather Case，塊皮一路包到保護殼側邊，仲有雙色設計嘅Modern Leather款。我今年有機會試咗佢同iPhone 18 Pro襯到絕嘅限定酒紅色特別版——一如既往咁出色。'}

{'原文': 'The brand also rolled out an all-new Rugged Case this year with the topography of the Baja California peninsula stamped into the side – it looks even better in person than it does on the website:', '譯文': '呢個品牌今年仲推出咗全新嘅Rugged Case保護殼，上面有類似下加利福尼亞地形圖嘅紋理設計，實物睇起上嚟比起網站靚好多：'}

{'原文': 'For a closer look at the 2026 Nomad iPhone 18 Pro lineup, be sure to revisit our hands-on coverage here and bring the promo codes along for the ride.', '譯文': '想近距離睇下2026年Nomad iPhone 18 Pro系列嘅設計，可以睇返我哋嘅開箱報導，記得帶埋以上嘅折扣碼一齊去睇。'}
